question: Can China NLC's own OPAC expose an official Zhunzhai companion/source record and object-level Copper/Zhunzhai binding beyond the union-catalog record boundary, without misclassifying OPAC/control/microfilm identifiers as a unique physical shelfmark?
answer: YES FOR THE OFFICIAL COMPANION/SOURCE-RECORD AND COMPOSITE-BINDING LAYER; NO FOR A UNIQUE PHYSICAL SHELFMARK. A SOURCE-BOUND NLC OPAC RESPONSE FOR 準齋心製几漏圖式 [縮微品] DIRECTLY EXPOSES MICROFILM DOC_NUMBER 002597934, OPAC ID 602003002862, 1985 NATIONAL MICROFILM-CENTER REPRODUCTION METADATA, AND A FIRST-PARTY '複製自' LINK TO ORIGINAL RARE-BOOK DOC_NUMBER 001775083 WITH SOURCE CONTROL 001411999008601. THE SAME OFFICIAL FIELD DIRECTLY STATES 原文獻03482銅壺漏箭制度、03483準齋心製几漏圖式為一冊 AND THAT 銅壺漏箭制度 WAS SEPARATELY PHOTOGRAPHED AT 00O003570. THIS CLOSES AN NLC OPAC-LEVEL COMPANION RECORD AND ONE-VOLUME ORIGINAL-DOCUMENT CROSS-BINDING. HOWEVER 03482/03483 ARE ONLY EXPLICITLY LABELLED 原文獻 NUMBERS IN THE REVIEWED FIELD, 00O003570 IS ONLY AN 另拍在 REFERENCE, AND 001411999008601 IS A SOURCE CONTROL VALUE; NONE IS PROMOTED TO A PHYSICAL CALL NUMBER, ACCESSION/DONATION NUMBER OR TIEQIN-ERA UNIQUE SHELFMARK WITHOUT AN EXPLICIT FIELD LABEL.
